text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for gpu-serving-prod: queue depth rising above threshold (xgpu-01 pool). Auto-scale attempted but failed to provision additional nodes.

sasha: I’m on it — seeing sustained queue growth on xgpu-01, tokens/sec per pod dropped ~40%. Adding logs now.

maria: Customer reports 5xxs for realtime endpoint in EU region. Which model pool is on xgpu-01?

sasha: It's the general-purpose small-rnn pool (gpp-small). Autoscaler returned errors: 
```json
{"error":"quota_exceeded","detail":"requested nodes > pool max_capacity"}
```

evan: Confirmed. The autoscaler hit the per-customer reserved limit (scale_cap). We have burst_policy set to false for this org. Queue is growing because continuous batching window increased — fewer dispatches.

ryan: Wait, batching window increased how? We didn't deploy batching changes today.

sasha: Rolling config shows a deploy from `deploy/optimizer` 18m ago that patched `continuous_batch.window_ms` from 8 -> 1200. Looks like a bad default.

amelia: Who approved that rollout? @maria any idea?

maria: That was an automatic rollout of the quantization/optimizer job — it accidentally included a config change. I’m reverting the rollout now and pausing further optimizer autosync.

infra-bot: Revert job queued: `deploy/optimizer@rev-7f2a` -> rolling back to `rev-7f2` (user: maria). Estimated user-visible change in 2m.

sasha: Meanwhile, we should open a mitigation to stop throttling on the front line. I'll flip `scale_override` to allow temporary burst to 2x capacity for xgpu-01. Need approval.

maria: Approve. Also alert the on-call infra team to request a temporary quota bump with cloud.

evan: Two quick things: (1) prefix cache TTL got set to 0 in the same deploy which is causing more cache misses and longer KV fetch latencies, and (2) batch_window_ms=1200 is combining many small requests into huge batches causing model latency spikes, backpressure, and fewer overall throughputs.

sasha: Adding mitigation steps into the incident doc: 
- rollback `deploy/optimizer` (maria)
- set `continuous_batch.window_ms` back to 8 (sasha)
- set `prefix_cache.ttl` to 600s (evan)
- temporary scale_override + request quota bump (ryan)
- notify support + customers (amelia)

ryan: I opened a support request with infra-quotas: SR-8421. Requested temporary GPU burst until EOD. Cloud response ETA ~ 30min.

maria: Revert applied. Patch ID: rev-7f2. Monitoring config propagation...

pagerbot: config-change: `deploy/optimizer` reverted by maria at 2551112380.

sasha: I patched `continuous_batch.window_ms=8` on the live routing layer to bypass the bad config until all agents converge. Applied on xgpu-01 and xgpu-02.

evan: I changed `prefix_cache.ttl` from 0 -> 600 on the central cache and warmed prefixes for common prompts. Added KV prefetch for top-10 templates.

amelia: Sending customer notice: "We're investigating increased latency and intermittent errors for realtime inference. Mitigation in progress; we'll post updates every 15m." Posting to support channel now.

ryan: Cloud quota updated: approved temporary burst +3 nodes for pool xgpu-01 at 2551112640. Autoscaler should be able to provision now.

infra-bot: Autoscaler events: provisioning 3 nodes -> join cluster at 2551112710.

sasha: Queue depth decreasing, dispatch rate returning to baseline. Tracking throughput and 5xx rate.

maria: Observability: request latency p50 back to normal, 5xxs down from 6.2% -> 0.9% in last 6m. Will keep monitoring for regressions.

evan: We need a postmortem action item: prevent config rollouts that touch batching and cache TTL in the same deploy without an explicit flag. Also add a pre-deploy config lint that rejects unbounded batch_window_ms > 1000ms.

amelia: Agreed. I'll draft the customer impact summary: affected customers (3 mid-market tenants), window of impact 2551112160 -> 2551112750, degraded throughput and 5xxs.

sasha: On-call handoff: I'm staying until system stabilizes, then will hand to next oncall at 2551113500.

maria: Followup tasks (short): 
- fix deploy gating for optimizer (maria)
- add autoscaler alert for "scale_request_denied" (evan)
- add preflight lint for batching TTL (ryan)
- add runbook snippet: temporary scale_override steps (sasha)

pagerbot: Incident acknowledged and converted to P1 postmortem ticket: PM-6337.

sasha: Thanks team. Closing live mitigations; moving to postmortem. :thumbsup:
